name: The Orchard — Tree Firmware
_note_new_install_prompt_erase: MUST stay false. Erasing wipes NVS, where a Tree's node_id, secp256r1 provenance key, HMAC secret and Pass claim nonce live. The firmware then boots, finds nothing, and mints a NEW identity — so every reflash created a new Tree and orphaned the old one. Six 'Trees' on one Orchard Pass, three registered within six minutes on 2026-06-16, were one board reflashed. Partition layouts are stable per board (ESP32 uses Arduino's default.csv; S3 uses partitions.csv) and the image is written at offset 0, so an erase is not needed for an update. Set it true ONLY to deliberately retire a board's identity.
